roadmap.title: Development roadmap
roadmap.intro: We ship in short cycles. Here is a snapshot of what is already live, what we are actively building, and what is next—so you always know where Corelia is headed.
roadmap.footerNote: Priorities can shift with partner programs and learner feedback. This page is updated when major milestones land.
shippedItems: Course catalog, checkout, and self-paced learning workspace
Hackathons: discovery, public hubs, and participant-facing flows
Account area: profile, billing basics, and achievements overview
Instructor workspace: course authoring and partner finance tools
Admin tools for users, instructors, and platform operations
Open Campus (OCID) linking for credentials and achievement claims
inProgressItems: Hackathon admin: richer creation, review, and publishing workflows
Public hackathon pages: timeline, prizes, rules, FAQs, and polish
Certificates & badges: smoother issuance and OC claim UX
Performance, accessibility, and onboarding refinements sitewide
plannedItems: Community layer: comments, showcases, and learner highlights
Stronger analytics for instructors and program owners
More payment and invoicing options where markets need them
Mobile-first improvements and optional PWA-style install
